column1: # character | meaning | mnemonic story (one line, plain English)
# Order is teaching order. Simple pictographs first, then the side forms that build most kanji.
一|one|A single flat line, like the horizon at dawn.
丨|stick|One upright stick planted in the ground.
丶|drop|A single drop of ink falling from the brush.
丿|slash|A quick slash of the brush from top right to bottom left.
乙|hook|A fishing hook bent back on itself.
二|two|Two lines stacked, the shorter on top.
十|cross|Two lines cross like a plus sign, the number ten.
人|person|A person walking, two legs mid-stride.
亻|person|A person standing upright at the side of a kanji.
儿|legs|Two little legs running away underneath.
八|split|Two strokes falling away from each other, splitting apart.
亠|lid|A pot lid with a small knob on top.
冖|crown|A cloth draped over something to cover it.
宀|roof|A roof with a chimney, sheltering what is under it.
卜|wand|A magic wand stuck upright in the ground.
口|mouth|An open square mouth, ready to speak or eat.
囗|enclosure|A big box that fences everything inside.
土|soil|A sprout pushing up out of a mound of soil.
大|big|A person stretching arms wide to show how big.
小|small|A tiny stick with two crumbs falling off it.
女|woman|A woman kneeling gracefully, arms crossed.
子|child|A child wrapped in a blanket, arms reaching out.
山|mountain|Three peaks rising, the middle one tallest.
川|river|Three streams of water flowing down side by side.
日|sun|The sun in a window frame, a bright line across it.
月|moon|A crescent moon hanging in the night sky.
木|tree|A tree with branches reaching up and roots reaching down.
火|fire|Flames leaping up with sparks flying out to both sides.
水|water|Water splashing out from a central stream.
氵|water|Three drops of water running down the side.
田|rice field|A rice paddy divided into four neat plots.
目|eye|An eye turned on its side, lashes and all.
耳|ear|An ear with its folds, listening closely.
手|hand|A hand with fingers spread and an arm below.
扌|hand|A hand reaching in from the side to grab.
力|power|A flexed arm showing off its strength.
刀|sword|A short blade with a curved handle.
夕|evening|A crescent moon just rising in the evening.
立|stand|A person standing firmly on the ground.
工|craft|An I-beam, the tool of a builder.
寸|measure|A hand measuring with one thumb-width.
彳|step|A line of people taking a step forward.
广|building|A slanted roof over a wide-open building.
門|gate|Two swinging doors of a big gate.
言|speech|Words tumbling out of a mouth, line after line.
貝|shell|A cowrie shell, the money of long ago.
雨|rain|Raindrops falling from a cloud under the sky.
艹|grass|Blades of grass sprouting along the top.
⻌|road|A winding road, moving along underneath.
食|eat|A lid over a bowl of food, ready to eat.
欠|yawn|A person yawning with a wide-open mouth.
斤|axe|A heavy axe ready to chop.
米|rice|Grains of rice scattering in every direction.
礻|altar|An altar where offerings are placed.
糸|thread|A twisted thread hanging from a spool.
止|stop|A footprint planted firmly: stop here.
馬|horse|A horse with its mane flying and four legs below.
